title_id.note: identity: the prepare step selects the profile by it

build.note: the builds the game was brought up on: version, display version (hle STR_DISPLAY_VERSION), module build IDs (which cuts apply)

package.note: the version the profile was made on (information: nxweb packs the newest in the folder, as nxnative)

modules.note: which code modules are loaded and in what order (prepare's Code stage)

romfs_marker.note: a path that must exist in the RomFS (prepare's Profile stage warns when it does not)

mem_used.note: kernel_init cfg +88 (GetInfo UsedMemorySize beside the heap)

sys_resource.note: kernel_init cfg +96 (GetInfo TotalSystemResourceSize); checked against main.npdm

mem_map_limit.note: kernel_init cfg flag 1 (MapPhysicalMemory fails past the pool)

game_args.note: arguments handed to the game before nninitStartup (no profile sets any)

alloc_big_align.note: hle_cfg CFG_ALLOC_BIG_ALIGN (StandardAllocator blocks of 64 KB and more aligned to 64 KB)

device_api.note: the NVN API version nvnDeviceGetInteger reports (an SDK version fact; no profile sets it, the SDK version decides)

pad_layout.note: input setting: which controls the game needs (simple / full / touch), a hint for the page's on-screen controls

mem_reserve.note: the Apple host's guest block size; nxweb's map is fixed in a 4 GB memory (see `address_space` under c when it does not fit)

mem_alias.note: the iPhone's alias region size; as mem_reserve

mem_stack.note: the Apple host's stack region size; nxweb's is 256 MB

shader_versions.note: which versions nxnative's offline shader tables are the union of

depth_mode.note: the depth mode for Metal pipelines made before the game runs; nxweb takes the game's nvnDeviceSetDepthMode call

draw_barriers.note: Metal render pass ordering (a GPU time optimization of nxnative's replayer)

vconv_range.note: the range of nxnative's CPU vertex conversion (an optimization of its replayer)

core_preempt.note: a scheduling remedy over pthreads; nxweb's kernel schedules the four cores itself

jit_key_data.note: the nn::jit image an iPhone (which cannot JIT) is served; nxweb translates code at run time

fps_target.what: The frame rate the game was tested at is not applied (nxnative writes the engine's frame limit or steps the game by the host's vsyncs); the game runs at its own rate.

fps_max.what: The 120 fps option is not available.

fps_hold.what: Frame holding under a frame-rate cap is not implemented.

present_interval.what: Presents are not re-paced to the display: the game keeps the present interval it asks for (often 30 fps).

ue_fps_cvar.what: The Unreal console variable that holds the frame limit is not written.

ue_texture_pool.what: Unreal's texture streaming pool is not raised: distant textures may stay blurry.

render_base.what: The render scale setting is not available.

screen_aspect.what: Only 16:9 output: the game's taller-screen mode is not available.

tex_flush_upload.what: Textures the game fills in place from the CPU and publishes with a pool flush are not uploaded: some textures may be missing or stale.

tex_dirty_upload.what: Textures the game rewrites in memory without telling NVN are not uploaded again (needs write tracking of guest pages).

render_cond.what: Conditional rendering (SetRenderEnableConditional) is not evaluated: some clears or draws may be wrong.

tex_dyn_slots.what: Shaders that index textures by a handle computed at run time are not supported.

gpu_timestamps.what: GPU timestamp reports are not per segment: a game that measures its GPU time may pick a wrong dynamic resolution.

shader_key_skip.what: Shader keys do not mask the control-section bytes this engine varies: every variant is translated separately (slow first use).

stdalloc_cap.what: The cap on nn::mem::StandardAllocator's address space is not applied: the game may run out of address space.

snowdrop_pools.what: Snowdrop's page pools are not resized: the engine reserves 12 GB of address space, which a 4 GB memory cannot give.

programs.what: A game of several programs: only the program in the folder runs; starting another program (oe::ExecuteProgram) is not implemented.

program_of.what: One program of a multi-program game: it runs alone, with the launch parameter of its profile.

address_space.note: wasm32: one 4 GB memory (memory64 or a smaller reported pool)
address_space.what: nxnative gives this game {detail}; a game that sizes its heap from the memory pool it is told about will ask for more than a 4 GB WebAssembly memory can map (the pool nxweb reports would have to be smaller; not tried).

unconverted_reasons.FRAME_STEP: frame-step and screen-shape stubs: code assembled into a patch area beside the module that reads a state page the host writes each frame; needs a patch area in the loader's map, the state page and the host's frame-step driver (nxnative hle_nvn.c fstep_tick)
unconverted_reasons.MATCH_FRAME_STEP: as FRAME_STEP, placed by a function fingerprint (nso_match.locate_stub), which also needs the matcher
unconverted_reasons.MATCH_CUTS: cuts located by complete-function fingerprints over the module's unwind table (nxnative dm/tools/nso_match.py, 356 lines, not ported); the registered builds' CUTS of the same patches are converted
unconverted_reasons.OBS: observation gates: a host callback at a pc; the translator hook exists in the hand-off format but no gate number has a nxweb callback

found_by_code.ue_cvar.py: Unreal console variables by their registered names (for fps_target, ue_texture_pool)
found_by_code.fps_target.py: a target frame rate global the game steps by
found_by_code.ue_malloc.py: Unreal's FMallocBinned3 constructor calls cut (37 GB reservation), the host's allocator in its place
found_by_code.unity_bucket.py: Unity 2019's bucket allocator reservation cut to 256 MB
found_by_code.snowdrop_pools.py: Snowdrop's three page pools resized (profile key snowdrop_pools)
found_by_code.ue_region.py: Unreal's 62 GB engine region sized to what the alias region has
found_by_code.ue_ring.py: Unreal's NVN dynamic buffers: 3 copies to 4
found_by_code.region_gates: observation gates on VammManager's AllocateAddressRegion / FreeAddressRegion (the host's region table)
found_by_code.spin waits: spin-wait loops copied behind a yield gate (not needed: src/prepare/README.md)
